sources.entry: JSON Editor - Dead simple JSON editor using josdejong/jsoneditor

summary.one_liner: A simple desktop JSON editor for Windows and Mac that wraps the josdejong/jsoneditor component.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes this app as a thin wrapper around josdejong/jsoneditor, a JSON editing component, packaged as a desktop application. It is presented as a simple JSON editor for Windows and Mac. The README gives no details about specific editing features, file handling, or keyboard shortcuts. Installation is by downloading a zip from the latest release page. The project is licensed under MIT. The README is short and includes a Japanese language switch.
use_cases: edit JSON files on Windows or Mac
view and modify JSON data in a simple GUI
lightweight alternative to a full IDE for JSON
how_to_run: Download the zip from the latest release page
Extract the zip and run the app
notable: Thin wrapper around the josdejong/jsoneditor component
Runs on both Windows and Mac
Available in English and Japanese README
caveats: README gives no details on features, supported versions, or build steps
Install relies on prebuilt zip downloads from releases
